note: See npm/settings.json for the placeholder rules. A setting goes into the [tool.uv] or [tool.uv.pip] table of pyproject.toml, or is a file of its own. path_marker puts a marker with that name first on PATH (the door's PATH never has project directories; the control shows what the setting would run). Both census shapes run: uv lock (edits, UV_PYTHON set as today) and uv pip compile (missing lock, as today in tailors/python/inputs.rs).
